user_query: I'm a music producer and I'm looking for new talents to work with. Can you help me find artists who have upcoming events and are featured on the top trending songs powered by Twitter? Also, provide me with the basic user information and tracks of the artist who sang the number one song on the Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs chart.

TaskList.description: Fetch the list of top trending songs from Twitter.
Extract the artists associated with the top trending songs obtained from Step 1.
For each artist from Step 2, check if they have any upcoming events.
Retrieve basic user information and tracks for the artist that sang the number one song on the Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs chart.
Compile the information on the artists with upcoming events and the details of the artist from Step 4.
